description: Scrape public LinkedIn posts, a profile's recent posts, comments and video metadata - no login or cookie needed.

cookie.description: Optional and never required - the actor works without any login. If supplied, it unlocks extra data: profile feeds paginate past the ~10-post cookieless ceiling up to Max Posts, and every post gains reaction-type breakdowns, reposts/views counts and the first page of likers/commenters. Accepts the li_at value, a raw cookie header, or a full cookies JSON array.
cookie.title: LinkedIn Cookie (optional)

cookies.description: Full browser cookie export for linkedin.com as a JSON array of {name, value} objects (Cookie-Editor extension -> Export -> JSON). Same effect as the Cookie field - merged with it when both are set. Optional and never required.
cookies.title: LinkedIn Cookies (JSON array, optional)

includeReposts.description: When off, reposts/reshared posts are excluded from the output.
includeReposts.title: Include Reposts

includeVideoTranscript.description: When on, video posts include the full spoken transcript (can make rows large).
includeVideoTranscript.title: Include Video Transcript

language.description: Language hint sent to LinkedIn. Affects localized content where available.
language.title: Language

maxComments.description: How many top comments to include per post. LinkedIn shows ~10 comments to logged-out visitors and the cookie path adds commenter profile URLs to those same first ~10 - a documented source ceiling either way.
maxComments.title: Max Comments per Post

maxInteractors.description: Cap applied separately to the likers list and the commenters list of each post when interactor scraping is enabled.
maxInteractors.title: Max Likers + Commenters per Post

maxPosts.description: Maximum number of posts to return. Cookieless profile feeds are capped by LinkedIn at the newest ~8 public posts; with the optional cookie the feed paginates up to this limit.
maxPosts.title: Max Posts

mediaTypes.description: Restrict output to specific post media types. Leave empty to keep all. Cookieless runs detect text, image, video and repost posts.
mediaTypes.title: Media Types

minComments.description: Skip posts that received fewer than this many comments. 0 keeps everything.
minComments.title: Minimum Comments

minReactions.description: Skip posts that received fewer than this many reactions. 0 keeps everything.
minReactions.title: Minimum Reactions

mode.description: What to scrape. "Auto" uses the URLs you provide; the actor picks the right pipeline automatically.
mode.title: Mode

postUrl.description: (mode=postUrls or auto) A LinkedIn post link, feed-update link, activity URN or bare activity ID. No login needed.
postUrl.title: Post URL

postUrls.description: (mode=postUrls) A list of LinkedIn post links, feed-update links, activity URNs or bare activity IDs. Combined with Post URL if both are set.
postUrls.title: Post URLs

postedAfter.description: Optional. Keep posts published on or after this date. Format: 2026-01-31 or full ISO 8601.
postedAfter.title: Posted After (date)

postedBefore.description: Optional. Keep posts published on or before this date. Format: 2026-01-31 or full ISO 8601.
postedBefore.title: Posted Before (date)

postedLimit.description: Keep only posts published within this window. "Any time" keeps everything.
postedLimit.title: Posted Within

profileUrl.description: (mode=profilePosts or auto) LinkedIn profile URL, e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/in/williamhgates, or just the username.
profileUrl.title: Profile URL

scrapeInteractors.description: Optional extra. Requires the LinkedIn Cookie field and adds the first page of commenters with profile URLs/headlines. Cookieless runs always include engagement counts and the top comments.
scrapeInteractors.title: Scrape Likers & Commenters (needs cookie)

scrapeReactions.description: With Scrape Likers & Commenters on, also include the first page of likers (name/headline/profile URL). Requires the optional cookie. LinkedIn's liker pagination endpoint is not available to visitors, so this is the visible first page only.
scrapeReactions.title: Include Likers List (needs cookie)

title: LinkedIn Post Scraper Input
